parts:
BioGeoBEARS Rcpp/RcppArmadillo issue fixed by updating R to
3.0.x:


On Tue, Mar 18, 2014 at 9:24 PM, X wrote:

Hi Nick,
I have a question about biogeoBEARS. I'm just
playing around with it trying to run the DEC models
and I'm having trouble getting it to run. I'm using
your online tutorial from phylo.wikidot.com
<http://phylo.wikidot.com>. Is that tutorial out of
date? Here is the error message I get when I just
try to load the program:

> library(BioGeoBEARS)
Loading required package: cladoRcpp
Loading required package: RcppArmadillo
Error in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()),
versionCheck = vI[[i]]) :
namespace ‘Rcpp’ 0.10.4 is already loaded, but >=
0.11.0 is required
Error: package ‘RcppArmadillo’ could not be loaded


I've tried installing the packages RcppArmadillo and
Rcpp, but it still doesn't work. Any suggestions?
Thanks, X




On Wed, Mar 19, 2014 at 9:14 AM, Nick Matzke
<mat...@nimbios.org <mailto:mat...@nimbios.org>> wrote:

Hi! My guess is you might need to update R to get the
newer versions of Rcpp and RcppArmadillo? R is now at
R3.0.4 or something, if you are back on R2.15 or so it
might cause this problem.

If your R is up to date and you still can't get the new
versions of Rcpp etc. to "take", do
remove.packages("Rcpp"), then close R, then open, then
install the packages again.

sessionInfo() shows what you've got...

Lemme know how it goes...cheers!
Nick
